candidate.title: KRAUS SIEVE MODULAR METHOD EXTENSION FOR SIGNATURE (3, 3, p) ON [5001, 5100]
candidate.claim: No non-trivial primitive solutions exist for signature (3, 3, p) for all prime exponents p in [5001, 5100].
candidate.method: Modular method level lowering to conductor 72, Kraus sieve relations at auxiliary primes q = 2kp + 1 with a_q(f) = 0 mod 2.
obligations: Compute Kraus certificates for all primes in [5001, 5100] and verify with PARI/GP and Lean 4.
candidate.novelty_note: Advances empirical verification frontier past the 5000 milestone to exponent 5100.
extracted: Kraus sieve eliminates all 4 primes p in [5001, 5100] with p = 1 mod 3; 8 primes with p = 2 mod 3 eliminated by Darmon-Merel.

has_reusable_lemma.instructions: Does this candidate contain an unconditionally proved lemma, modular trace identity, or arithmetic bound that remains valid even if the headline claim is blocked/refuted?

criteria.true: Yes, contains genuinely proved, mathematically reusable lemmas.
criteria.false: No, the entire content is conditional, flawed, or trivial.

criteria.galois_inertia_weight: Bounds on inertia action or Fontaine-Laffaille Serre weights.
criteria.cohomology_dimension_bound: Exact dimensions or vanishing of low-degree cohomology / Selmer groups.
